test_title: SSC GD Constable (2022) Official Paper (Held On : 09 Feb 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.**

I was looking forward to a ______ evening at home.
solution: The correct answer is "quiet."** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The word** "quiet"** means with very little or no noise. (शांत, ख़ामोश) • **Example**: *After a hard day at work, all she wanted was some peace and **quiet**__.* • The sentence wants to convey that he/she wanted to have a noiseless evening. • The correct answer is option 2. **Correct sentence**: *I was looking forward to a __**quiet**__ evening at home.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] __Additional Information__ • Quit: **to leave a job, etc. or to go away from a place. (कोई नौकरी या स्‍थान छोड़ना) • **Quite: **not very; to a certain degree; rather. (अधिक नहीं; किसी हदतक; अपेक्षाकृत) • **Quote: **to repeat exactly something that somebody else has said or written before. (पहले कही या लिखी गई बात को सही-सही दोहराना, दूसरे के शब्‍दों को उद्‌धृत करना) 196:T44b, The correct answer is: **'A small punishment'**.
